en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam who said,

‘I was selling Al-Sabiriyya (a fabric) in the shade, so Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> passed by me, so he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘O Hisham! The selling in the shade (in darkness) is cheating, and that cheating is not Permissible’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam who has said the following:

“Once when I was selling al-Sabiriy (a certain kind of fabric) in the shade, abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al- Salam, passed by and said to me, ‘O Hisham, selling in shade is cheating and cheating is not lawful.’”
